{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsorlift propulsion unit''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] locomotion component. The [[A5-series Assassin Droid]] used a repulsorlift propulsion unit to move around.

[[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|Zero G assault stormtroopers]] also utilized these. They are incorporated into their armor's back pack.
